quest.title: A Meeting of "Puppets"
quest.description: Go to Lambad's Tavern, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Hat Guy...

talks.objective: Head for the vicinity of Lambad's Tavern to begin the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Hat Guy
dialogues.text: This really is hard to believe. I never imagined I'd be sitting here drinking tea with you.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Is it really that strange? I just wanted to thank you for the core processing unit you provided for the numerological array.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: And why do you keep talking like you know us inside out? You make it seem like you have a deep understanding.

dialogues.speaker: Hat Guy
dialogues.text: I told you, I'm a good judge of character.

dialogues.speaker: Hat Guy
dialogues.text: Still... Haha, you said it right. I shouldn't keep assuming I understand you.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Oh?

dialogues.speaker: Hat Guy
dialogues.text: Even compared to our last meeting, I feel like you've changed a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hmph! It doesn't matter how far back you want to "compare," the only changes I've undergone are to accept the errors in my core and open my eyes to see a few things clearly.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: And what about you? As a fellow "puppet" of sorts, do you ever experience computational errors in your heart?

dialogues.speaker: Hat Guy
dialogues.text: Hah... I experience far more than just errors!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Do tell.

dialogues.speaker: Hat Guy
dialogues.text: I don't think we know each other well enough for that just yet.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Heh, have it your way. I was merely asking out of courtesy.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Regardless, it takes a good many detours before a puppet can find its heart. At least, it did for me.

dialogues.speaker: Hat Guy
dialogues.text: You seem to have a good relationship with your creator...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I did. He gave me a lot of help and guidance, both in life... and after.

dialogues.speaker: Hat Guy
dialogues.text: In that regard, there's a fundamental difference between us.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: ...Oh. Is that so?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I'm sorry. Even though we share some similarities as puppets, I shouldn't have assumed to know anything about you based on that alone.

dialogues.speaker: Hat Guy
dialogues.text: Don't worry about it. To borrow a phrase from you, I, too, have accepted my past errors.

dialogues.speaker: Hat Guy
dialogues.text: It's just that I've taken too many detours already. I need to walk an even longer path to make up for them all.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: In that case... good luck? To borrow a phrase in return, I don't know you well enough yet to give any further advice.

dialogues.speaker: Hat Guy
dialogues.text: Haha... Well said.

talks.objective: Head for the vicinity of Lambad's Tavern to begin the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Hat Guy
dialogues.text: We each have our own paths to walk. There's no need to say anything more. This tea is quite good, by the way.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)

dialogues.speaker: Hat Guy
dialogues.text: Alright, goodbye.
